purpose: idt(1.0, 0) integrates to the unit ramp: v(out) = t at every accepted point.

oracle.derivation: LRM 4.5.4 Table 4-18: idt(expr, ic) = integral(t0..t) expr dtau + ic. With expr == 1 and ic == 0 the exact value is t - t0 = t. LRM 4.5.15 puts the operator's internal state on the accepted-time lifetime, and the accepted dt sum to t by construction, so the identity is independent of the step sequence and of the integration method. Linear in t, so linear interpolation between accepted points at the sample times is exact too.
